allowedPrivateReviewerStatements: P61 records a fail-closed unsupported-construct blocker gate against the P60 schema.
All six P59/P60 unsupported forms are represented as blocked schema-shaped probes.
P61 can be used to keep unsupported constructs from being mistaken for implemented branch support.
blockedStatements: Loops, effects, calls, memory, labels, nested branches, and source-preserving roundtrip are supported.
General C/Rust branch/control-flow support is established.
Full non-generated C/Rust source roundtrip is supported.
Arbitrary C/Rust source-family support is established.
Formal semantic equivalence has been proved.
nextMilestones: Build a nested-branch fixture matrix for grammar breadth.
Build an assignment/phi fixture gate for dominance and merge semantics.
Only after those gates, consider a narrow schema-backed frontend adapter.

semanticObligations.description: C/Rust comparison and boolean semantics must be explicit before branch equivalence claims.
Each selected value must come from a dominating definition or explicit phi/select merge.
Early returns and fallthrough returns must normalize to equivalent exit behavior.
Mutable updates must preserve statement order and branch-local state.
Loops, labels, effects, calls, and memory must fail closed until separately validated.
Non-generated source branches need a source AST boundary before full roundtrip claims.
